entry.title: From Loops to Graphs: My Journey Building AI Agents

link.title: From Loops to Graphs: My Journey Building AI Agents

entry.content:
My first journey started in early 2025 because during that time we have a bunch of repeated task, where we need to diagnose batch ingestion failure. So I was thinking maybe we can build a chatbot (that time the word “agent” has not very popular) and help reduce the human effort.

So I build a prompt chaining workflow using CrewAI and picked LLama 3 served by OLLaMa:
entry.summary: How my agent architecture evolved from early prototypes to MCP, LangGraph, tool loops, skills, and graph-based orchestration
